title: $100,000 to Whoever Build the Best Apps!
description:
Build a fully functional marketplace app without writing a single line of code. You just describe what you need, and the AI handles the database and deployment in minutes.

This method is perfect for anyone wanting to launch a web app quickly without hiring developers. We walk through the entire process from initial prompt to a live, working product.
